data.intro: ECMAScript (/ˈɛkməskrɪpt/; ES)[1] is the standard for the JavaScript language, intended to ensure the interoperability of web pages across different web browsers.[a][2] It is standardized by Ecma International's TC39 technical committee in the document ECMA-262, with i18n ("Intl") APIs standardized in the document ECMA-402.[3]
